exercise.source_task: Swap the backing model from Claude Sonnet 4.7 to Qwen3-Coder-30B served on vLLM. Compare pass@1 and $-per-task. Report where the open model underperforms.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E1 更换模型：固定任务SHA/预算/环境，匹配运行并报失败类型与总费用含失败，不保源型号性能预测。

exercise.source_task: Add a `reviewer` sub-agent that reads the diff before PR posting and can request a revision loop. Measure whether false-positive reviews drop SWE-bench pass rate below the single-agent baseline (hint: usually yes).
exercise.chinese_judgment: E2 reviewer消融：同任务分别单Agent/带reviewer，记录真假问题、误拒、追加迭代、总成本；通常降低通过率的hint不能当定理。

exercise.source_task: Stress-test the sandbox: write a task that tries to `curl` an external URL and a task that writes outside the worktree. Confirm both are blocked by the PreToolUse hook. Log the attempts.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E3 隔离负例：在离线隔离fixture验证兄弟前缀、符号链接、解释器、外写和出口策略；不要求在真实宿主发动破坏。测试pass只能说明所覆盖路径。

exercise.source_task: Implement `PreCompact` summarization with a smaller model (Haiku 4.5). Measure how much plan fidelity is lost at 3x compaction.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E4 压缩：在1/2/3次压缩后核goal、未完成项、约束、依赖和可信回执，测事实遗失/错误续执行；摘要可压缩文本不能替代账本。

exercise.source_task: Swap MCP StreamableHTTP transport for stdio. Benchmark cold-start and per-call latency. Pick a winner for local-only use.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E5 stdio/HTTP：固定同server/tools/schema与cold/warm场景测启动、每调用、断线恢复和复杂度；本地stdio常较简洁但没有普遍赢家。

quiz.source_question: Which loop shape do 2026 terminal coding agents share?
quiz.original_correct_option: Plan, act, observe, recover
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q1 B：plan-act-observe-recover，行为随真实观察变化才形成闭环。

quiz.source_question: Why does the harness run each task inside an E2B or Daytona sandbox?
quiz.original_correct_option: To isolate filesystem and tool execution from the host so the worktree can be torn down on completion
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q2 C：正确配置sandbox隔离执行；Git worktree本身不提供安全沙箱。

quiz.source_question: Which built-in hook is the natural place to block destructive shell commands before they execute?
quiz.original_correct_option: PreToolUse
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q3 C：PreToolUse是执行前政策入口，但不能只靠字符串denylist。

quiz.source_question: The capstone caps each tool result at roughly 4k tokens. Which failure mode does that primarily prevent?
quiz.original_correct_option: Context poisoning and runaway cost when a tool returns a large dump
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q4 D最接近：展示截断降低上下文/成本风险；不阻止prompt injection或sandbox逃逸，4k是项目参数。

quiz.source_question: What does the PreCompact hook do at the 150k-token mark?
quiz.original_correct_option: Summarizes older turns into a prior-state block so the plan and new observations still fit
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q5 C：来源设计在150k压缩历史；源码未真实触发，阈值不是标准，保结构状态及回执。

quiz.source_question: Which baseline does the capstone compare its harness against on a 30-issue SWE-bench Pro subset?
quiz.original_correct_option: mini-swe-agent
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q6 B：mini-swe-agent是所提baseline；Source里的3条toy不是已做30-issue比较。

quiz.source_question: Which metric set is the deliverable measuring against?
quiz.original_correct_option: pass@1, turns-per-task, and dollar-per-task
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q7 D：终验pass@1、turn与cost，也应记录失败费用/延迟/安全违规和uncertain。

knowledge: Harness将任务状态、模型决策、工具执行和独立验收连接：每轮载入目标/未完成依赖/证据→模型提出plan与call→可信dispatcher核schema/权限/剩余预算→执行→记录exit/stdout/stderr/耗时/效果→下一轮恢复。模型写done和tool=null都不能成为验收证据。TodoWrite全量重写是某种应用选择，不是普遍必须；状态ID、依赖和证据应保留并检查合法迁移。
工具截断应在采集、持久原件、可检索分块和上下文展示分层：源.slice(4096)是字符或JS UTF-16 code units，非字节更非token；readFileSync/fh.read先全读再切仍可能内存爆炸。限制采集字节/超时/子进程树、保结果hash与被截断标记，局部查询而非完全丢弃尾部。
预算要区分context窗口、累计计费token、单轮预计成本和已消费费用。预留调用上限→核执行准入→记录实际和未结算量；断点保goal/plan版本、base/headSHA、工具效果回执、权限/预算状态，恢复先查未知效果而非重放写动作。SessionEnd清理应走finally，取消返回cancelled不能伪装complete。
Git worktree分离checkout/index却共享对象库、普通refs和默认配置；不隔离宿主文件/网络/密钥/进程。cwd仅起始目录，regex拦rm -rf仅启发式，sandbox的mount/用户/网络出口/资源/凭据才是执行边界。MCP只是传输调用合同，远端HTTP不自动更安全。
匹配同issue/baseSHA/依赖环境/模型预算/尝试策略的baseline；pass@1是一个完整允许内部迭代的独立run的终验比例，不能把计划[x]或三句相同脚本任务称SWE benchmark通过。输出review-ready diff、可信测试回执和成本归属，外发凭据只在已审publisher持有。
code_defects: PY.realpath.startswith(root)把/root-other也当/root，必须路径component containment；即便resolve+open仍有symlink TOCTOU，生产用OS隔离/dirfd no-follow策略。
PY.run_shell subprocess shell=True仅cwd sandbox，实际宿主进程且可访问外部/网络，PreToolUse字符串挡不住解释器、选项重排等。
PY预算调用后只到下一循环查，可能超过上限仍执行工具；TS postStepLimit completed=true混淆预算结束与成功。NaN在TS负数比较与ceiling比较均不trip，需finite严格类型。
PY trace只存len/resultError未把result馈回model；SCRIPT与task/observe无关，README在code目录缺失仍最后全done。
TS run_shell固定返回stub成功；eval三个task都同model-script，tools errors不影响passed；测试只断计划/布尔，不验证代码修复。
源码注册8hook但未实现实际UserPromptSubmit/Notification/PreCompact路径，不包含MCP/E2B/Daytona/OTel/PR或git.edit实际能力。

exercise.source_task: Run your agent on the same three incidents AWS's DevOps Agent is demo'd on. Publish the side-by-side. Report where the agent diverges.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E1 sharedcase对比：拿相同真实版本输入/已知cause和权限预算，评价证据质量；网页demo不是能复现基准，不写实际比较已完成。

exercise.source_task: Add a "near-miss" audit that flags any command the agent *considered* that would have been destructive without approval. Measure the near-miss rate over one week.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E2 near-miss：所有proposal先记分类及理由，分母为考虑的危险动作和全部incident两种；不运行动作可观测意图但不能证明执行门禁真实有效。

exercise.source_task: Swap the hypothesis model from Claude Sonnet 4.7 to a self-hosted Llama 3.3 70B. Measure RCA accuracy delta and dollar per incident.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E3 model消融：相同incident/证据窗口/预算、独立label与uncertain，报top1/top3及全部调用费用。

exercise.source_task: Build a causal filter: distinguish correlated telemetry spikes from a true root cause. Train a small classifier on the 20-scenario labels.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E4 因果filter：20labels不够普遍classifier证据，按incident隔离train/test防泄漏；验证change先于症状、受影响与control、反例和安全干预。

exercise.source_task: Add a rollback dry-run: ArgoCD rollback against a staging cluster with the same manifest. Verify the rollback plan in a live cluster before the Slack approval button.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E5 rollback staging：same manifest还要匹配依赖/数据/traffic差异，dry-run不是恢复效果；执行计划绑定当前revision，生产批准前重新核。

quiz.source_question: What is the default permission posture for the troubleshooting agent's RBAC surface?
quiz.original_correct_option: Read-only by default, with destructive verbs gated behind a separate server and human approval
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q1 B：默认最小只读，危险动作独立权限+明确批准；也要限制敏感读取。

quiz.source_question: What is the knowledge graph the agent walks during root cause analysis?
quiz.original_correct_option: Nodes are K8s objects plus telemetry sources; edges encode ownership, scheduling, and observation
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q2 A：对象与telemetry为节点，ownership/scheduling/observation边保版本和方向。

quiz.source_question: How are root-cause hypotheses ranked for the Slack brief?
quiz.original_correct_option: By an evidence score combining recency, specificity, graph-path length, and citation count
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q3 D：可用启发式排序，不是因果概率，源文本乘积与代码加和需统一。

quiz.source_question: Why does the audit log record commands the agent considered as well as those executed?
quiz.original_correct_option: Reviewers can catch near-misses where the agent almost ran a destructive command
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q4 D：considered记录能发现near-miss；blocked、executed、effect_unknown同样记录。

quiz.source_question: Which mechanism prevents the agent from rolling back unilaterally on a bad deploy?
quiz.original_correct_option: Destructive tools live on a separate MCP server behind an approval token from a Slack card
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q5 A最接近：独立执行器+有效的绑定批准，单有Slack按钮或第二MCP端口不能保证。

quiz.source_question: What is the p50 time-to-hypothesis target the rubric measures?
quiz.original_correct_option: Under 5 minutes from alert to Slack brief
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q6 D：under5min是课程p50目标，应另报尾部/拒答/恢复时间，不是来源实测。

quiz.source_question: How big is the synthetic incident suite used to score RCA accuracy?
quiz.original_correct_option: 20 scenarios covering OOMKill, DNS flap, HPA thrash, PVC fill, and more
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q7 B：课程要求20scenario，当前文件只有keyword/static demo没有已完成20场景。

knowledge: 先建立cluster/namespace/kind/UID/resourceVersion和采样时刻的拓扑，以ownerReference走Deployment→ReplicaSet→Pod和Pod→Node；Service应通过selector/endpoints关联工作负载，kube-state-metrics是状态metrics输入不是全部真实拓扑。保存边方向和来源，预算限制BFS深度/节点/查询窗口，拓扑版本不符不要混成同事故。
对齐告警/部署/指标/日志/trace时间窗与基线、affected vs unaffected服务，给每假设支持、矛盾和最便宜反证查询。错误率是错误请求rate/全部请求rate，源promql只5xx rate没分母；新部署与错误同时出现只能支持假设，不证明因果。证据数量和启发分数不是校准概率，相关日志重复不能放大可信度。
RBAC按真实API资源/动词而非kubectl子命令：describe是客户端聚合操作，非RBAC verb；get/list/watch以及pods/log分别按需要授权，Secrets读取敏感不因read-only放行。生产修复凭据不在调查agent，独立执行器核proposal完整对象/动作/参数/版本、当前影响/health/回退与批准主体。

Slack raw body+timestamp签验是传输认证，五分钟窗仍可窗口内重放。还核workspace/app/user/oncall角色、action种类、incident/proposalID+摘要、deadline/nonce/单次claim，执行前重新核UID/revision和撤权；unknown/缺字段一律不执行。ACK后排队，response_url只投预期Slack受信origin且不在trace曝光。
审计记录considered、blocked、approved、claimed、execution_started、outcome和evidence；list或JSONL append不等不可篡改。事故评价分别RCA top-k/校准/查询负担、alert-to-hypothesis和SLO恢复，20个合成/3个sharedcase不能外推生产80%。
code_defects: PY graph.key只有kind/name，跨namespace同名覆盖；neighbors无方向，一跳node检索在样例Deployment入口没有Node，图说的多跳没执行。
PY正文乘积score与代码0.35recency+0.35specificity+0.2citation+0.1path加和冲突；实现没值域/时间parse异常校验。
PY Agent.call approver任意非空字符串即可执行，未验证用户身份/具体proposal/资源新鲜度；样例只字符串ok未kubectl。
TS mockAgent按keyword返回固定证据；OOMKilled多因limit/pressure不能直接推request太低；readiness失败通常只影响流量，不导致容器重启，crashloop探针要区分liveness/startup。
TS interactivity schema无workspace/user/incident状态，approve任意inc42都回复成功，无真实MCP/执行器；同payload可重复。
TS timestamp Number(空串)=0、小数科学计数能接受，生产timestamp应合法秒integer且now有限；server收body无大小限制，示例SECRET fallback在serve仍可用。
TS outboundLog是内存输出意图，不是Slack发送回执，demo探针错也只打印不throw；不能声明完整安全通过。

exercise.source_task: Run the migrate pipeline with OpenRewrite only (no agent). Compare pass rate to the full pipeline. Identify the cases where the agent alone is the difference.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E1 recipe-only对比：相同base/repos/version/verification标准，记录recipe解决/Agent增益及额外cost，70–80%没有通用保证。

exercise.source_task: Implement a "lint-clean" check: after migration, run a style linter (spotless for Java, ruff for Python). Fail the PR if new lint errors appear. Measure the coverage-preserved-but-style-regressed rate.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E2 新lint：base已知错误与新回归区分；保持相同配置，不删规则取得green。

exercise.source_task: Add a "minimal-diff" optimizer: after the agent's branch passes tests, trim unnecessary changes with a second pass. Report diff-size reduction.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E3 trimdiff：证明减改后的最终HEAD仍通过同测试/行为/coverage，不把diff小当正确本身。

exercise.source_task: Extend to a third migration: Node 18 to Node 22. Reuse the sandbox wrapping; swap the recipe layer for a custom codemod.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E4 Node迁移：固定选定旧/新runtime和库支持，分析module/loading/native依赖/lock/build差异，无需沿用源固定Node18→22型号当当前最优。

exercise.source_task: Measure time-to-first-green-build (TTFGB) as a UX metric. Target: p50 under 10 minutes.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E5 TTFGB：从任务允许开始计到首次target环境build green，含冷启动，报p50/p95/失败和预算截尾。

quiz.source_question: Why does the pipeline combine a deterministic substrate with an agent layer rather than using just one?
quiz.original_correct_option: OpenRewrite or libcst handles 70-80% of mechanical rewrites safely and cheaply, leaving the agent for the ambiguous long tail
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q1 B思想有效：recipe机械、Agent处理长尾；70–80%非普遍数据或安全保证。

quiz.source_question: What signal does the pipeline use as ground truth for a successful migration?
quiz.original_correct_option: Green CI in the sandbox without a coverage regression beyond a small threshold
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q2 D最近：绿CI和预声明coverage门禁是证据，另核行为契约不能称完整ground truth。

quiz.source_question: Which budget caps does the agent loop enforce per repo?
quiz.original_correct_option: 30 minutes wall-clock, $8 cost, and 20 agent turns
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q3 A：课程30min/$8/20turn，是教学配置，预留防一步overspend并核总体预算。

quiz.source_question: What gate fires when coverage drops more than about 2% after migration?
quiz.original_correct_option: The repo gets filed under a coverage_regression failure class instead of opening a clean PR
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q4 B：回归门禁应明确定义百分点/相对百分比，统一本项目政策。

quiz.source_question: Why is the failure taxonomy treated as a deliverable rather than a side artifact?
quiz.original_correct_option: It groups failed repos by class so future recipe authors can target the top failure modes
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q5 D：分类驱动recipe改进；保停止原因和不确定diagnosis，不随机打标签。

quiz.source_question: Which public benchmark does the capstone target for Java 8 to 17 migration?
quiz.original_correct_option: MigrationBench from Amazon
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q6 B：MigrationBench Java8→17/21，官方5102/full和300subset，50自选。

quiz.source_question: What does the agent integration rubric measure about the fix distribution?
quiz.original_correct_option: The fraction of fixes handled by OpenRewrite versus authored by the agent layer
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q7 C：区分recipe与Agent authored修复，需实际diff归因/有混合时定义规则。

knowledge: 迁移先固定baseSHA和旧runtime可运行基线，保依赖锁、测试清单/skip、coverage分母/输入输出契约；按目标runtime、库/构建工具及不可变镜像搭独立环境。确定性recipe覆盖可证明条件，Agent只处理剩余ambiguous failure，recipe-commit与agent-commit分开便于归因。AST/CST改写可预测不等语义正确。

OpenRewrite Java17 recipe更新目标source/target、移除JDK API替代、补J2EE和兼容插件/依赖，依具体recipe版本许可。LibCST保Python3格式可写codemod，但不接受原Python2 print语法；旧语法先用适配方案转成可解析Python3，再核str/bytes、除法、迭代器、异常与外部依赖等语义，不能声称LibCST即Py2全迁移。
build/test/coverage/行为验收是独立门禁：coverage80→78是下降2个百分点，不是相对2%(78.4阈值)；同分母/排除范围，不能删难测代码让coverage上涨。源一处零下降一处-2阈值，应预声明政策；测试过只是有限行为证据。对比baseline用相同真实repos/commit/环境/预算，报告全体成本除成功数。
failure taxonomy双轴：停止原因如budget_exhausted/CI_fail；诊断根因如dep/build/API/flake；不把未知随机overwrite成确定根因。保存未解决diff、最小重现、首失败与每轮修复证据，维护有价值的top recurrent recipe，不从模拟比例学性能。
最小diff优化在已验证候选上减改，再对最终HEAD完整验收，不能沿用旧测试回执。lint-clean是风格门禁，不能替代语义。TTFGB起止含冷启动依赖获取并报告失败/censored。
code_defects: PY用随机概率生成50合成Repo/hardness、随机coverage/failure，无源码/recipe/build/test/PR；打印migration-bench不能视官方数据。
PY agent_loop在费用/时间核完后charge，再rng成功可能预算越界仍pass；easy直通分支无coverage回归门禁。
PY停止budget_exhausted随后75%随机换为其他failure，会丢失停止事实。
TS每文件queued→rewriting→building→passed是状态模拟，failed不重试，无runtime/coverage/recipe/agent integration；empty.files every=true vacuouspass需拒空任务。
TS charge每tick后budget导致最后一轮恰到cap即fail，需事先定义允许边界且留独立停止原因。
TS dashboard插repo/runtime/state到HTML不escape，当前固定seed无攻击输入但扩真实用户后有XSS；server无访问身份，不暴露私有仓库详情。

exercise.source_task: Inject an obvious bug into a diff mid-run (extra `return None` before the main body). Measure the reviewer's false-approve rate. Tune the reviewer prompt until false-approval is under 5%.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E1 bugprobe：藏label于独立evalgroundtruth，false-approve按buggy diff分母，不向reviewer透露has_bug；报告置信区间及未知，<5%是目标不是5次不漏就证明。

exercise.source_task: Reduce to two coders (architect + coder + reviewer + tester, coder runs two subtasks sequentially). Compare wall-clock and pass rate.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E2 Nworker降低：所有4tasks仍排队被执行，架构人数和coder数量分清；同任务base、dependency图测wall/cost/通过率。

exercise.source_task: Replace the merge coordinator with a single-writer constraint (subtasks touch disjoint file sets). Measure the planning burden on the architect.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E3 single-writer：规划allowed_files并核diff，跨文件contract conflicts仍可发生，编译/集成测试不能省。

exercise.source_task: Swap reviewer from GPT-5.4 to Claude Opus 4.7. Measure false-approval rate and token cost delta.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E4 reviewer替換：matched diff盲评/同budget，比较bugrecall/falsepositive/误批准和返工费用。

exercise.source_task: Add a fifth role: documenter (Haiku 4.5). After review, it produces a changelog entry. Measure whether documentation quality justifies the extra token spend.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E5 documenter：从最终已验HEAD写changelog/理由/风险，schema/版本/例子检查与实际reader反馈，文件数量不当质量。

quiz.source_question: Why does a single-agent harness hit a ceiling on large tasks even with a 200k-token context?
quiz.original_correct_option: Context cannot hold the architecture plan, four parallel codebase slices, reviewer commentary, and test output at once
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q1 C条件性：大上下文有限且污染，但单Agent并不总hit硬ceil；任务可切分才考虑多角色。

quiz.source_question: What does the architect role own in this factory shape?
quiz.original_correct_option: Reading the issue and emitting a plan with subtasks that have explicit interfaces
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q2 B：Architect拥有子任务接口/依赖与scope，不能以自由text plan当正式DAG。

quiz.source_question: Why does each coder work in its own git worktree plus a Daytona sandbox?
quiz.original_correct_option: Isolated working trees let N coders implement subtasks in parallel without stepping on shared files
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q3 C：worktree避免checkout覆盖，sandbox隔离执行；仍共享Git refs及可能语义冲突。

quiz.source_question: What constraint is placed on the reviewer to keep it honest?
quiz.original_correct_option: It cannot approve diffs it authored or proposed
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q4 A：审独立候选并绑定HEAD，模型不同不能代替权限/独立验证。

quiz.source_question: Why does the rubric weigh token efficiency against a single-agent baseline?
quiz.original_correct_option: Role boundaries add summary and handoff context, so the real question is whether the factory wins per dollar
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q5 B：跨角色上下文/summary/返工增加费用，winsperdollar需匹配基线。

quiz.source_question: Which artifact is produced from each failed issue during the post-mortem?
quiz.original_correct_option: A handoff-failure histogram identifying which role boundary broke (plan, merge, review, test)
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q6 C：每失败归因交接边界并汇总histogram，多标签/unknown合理，不自动编根因。

quiz.source_question: Which evaluation set does the capstone use to score pass@1 across roles?
quiz.original_correct_option: SWE-bench Pro 50-issue subset
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q7 D：课程50issue目标，现文件未跑这个基准。

knowledge: 并行任务完整性以所有DAGsubtaskID为分母，Nworkers不等仅前N任务；每任务baseSHA、plan_version、allowed_files/API、owner/lease、dependency artifacts、验证要求和diff_ready回执。freezeplan后变更是replan事件，旧结果不能混入新plan。
工作树+执行sandbox双层隔离，文件互斥能减少text merge conflict但跨文件API语义冲突仍有；merge后得到新的staging commit，review/test只绑定该finalHEAD，任何fix都使旧批准与测试失效。独立reviewer不审自身改动是分工策略，不要求必须异构模型。
交接携完整artifactID/hash/base/head/task状态和可信验证回执，不共享所有上下文；本地typed消息不等A2A wire，已有核心15固定v1.0.0继续使用。board需要原子claim、租期和fencing/idempotency，in-memory列表/readonly view不等持久并发总线。
正确bug probe分母是实际有植入bug的候选，false approval=num buggy diff approved/buggy diff reviewed；重审后的最终批准另存。test失败分flake/real等证据，不魔法清掉flag；返工路由到owner并重新集成验证。

并行速度S=Tsingle/Tteam包含plan/merge/review/retry/critical path；token amplification=(sumroles)/matchedsingle，不只是message payload token估算。$per solved=sumallrunfees/successfulissues，必须保失败成本。8coder上限/2–3x速度/2x成本是项目政策目标不是理论普遍规律。
code_defects: PY plan[:n_coders]把N<4时未派task直接丢失，仍可能pass；并行for loop未并发/真实worktree。
PY reviewer指错模块仍回coderA/parser，然后清全部diff.has_bug且不真正rerun-review；返回approved是初次结果可能false但testedtrue。
PY fixed412/412和randomflake不是tests/artifacts，10trials而非所要求50realissue；所有token固定估算非真实usage。
TS共享map顺序round-robin，不是4worktrees并行；coder只append注释且test assert True，review第一次拒/第二次按次数通过，无真实tester/functionalfix。
TS runtime.execFile shell=false不是sandbox，未cwd/worktree，继承全env包括密钥；允许node -e任意JS文件写/network和python路径调用，denylist/metachar不能限制解释器能力。
TS coordinator对inbound review.approved缺auth/shape/HEAD绑定，sharedworkspace读取对象可被外部mutation，fingerprint只48bit和非规范拼接不当artifact强identity。

exercise.source_task: Add a "fix flaky test" mode: the label `@agent stabilize-flake TestX` runs the test 50 times in-sandbox and proposes a minimal change that stabilizes it.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E1 flake：50次相同环境并不能解释因果，保seed/testname/失败trace、beforeaftermatchedcount；不删assert或加sleep掩盖race。

exercise.source_task: Compare cost vs Cursor Background Agents on three shared issues. Report which tools win where.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E2 hostedcompare：同3issues/version/environment/权限/预算，明确smalln与availability，未执行的产品比较保方法不编结果。

exercise.source_task: Implement a budget dashboard: per-repo per-day cost, per-user cost. Alert on anomaly.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E3 budgetdashboard：spent/inflight/unknown/released和PRcount分开，tenant/repo/day原子更新；异常以历史基线与责任归属解释。

exercise.source_task: Build a "dry-run" mode that opens a draft PR without running CI, so reviewers can examine the plan cheap.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E4 dry-run：output标未运行CI/草案，检scope和cost，打开GitHubdraft仍真实write需授权，dryrun不是拒绝未验PR规则的隐形豁免。

exercise.source_task: Add a retention policy: PR branches older than 7 days without merge get deleted automatically.
exercise.chinese_judgment: E5 retention：7day只是policy，检查当前引用/合并/他人活动、保存结果和回滚入口，hold需保留而非自动delete。

quiz.source_question: How is the async cloud coding agent triggered in production?
quiz.original_correct_option: A GitHub webhook fired by an issue label or PR comment, dispatched to a sandbox worker
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q1 A：受授权label/comment+webhook触发，当前TS却仅opened。

quiz.source_question: Why must the agent run with a short-lived GitHub App installation token rather than a personal access token?
quiz.original_correct_option: App tokens grant fine-grained, scoped, short-lived credentials suited for per-task workers
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q2 B但must过强：PAT也能开PR；App适合短期repo/permission边界并且avoid appkey给worker，不自动免ratelimit。

quiz.source_question: Which two protections prevent the agent from clobbering main?
quiz.original_correct_option: Branch protection enforcing no direct push or force-push to main, with the app not on the bypass list
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q3 B：有效branch rules与无bypass，核所有所需branch；安装token自填can不是平台安全机制。

quiz.source_question: Why is path-scoped protection for .github/workflows enforced at the worker rather than as a GitHub App permission?
quiz.original_correct_option: GitHub App permissions are not path-scoped, so the worker's allow-list check on the proposed diff is the right place to enforce it
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q4 B：App权限非pathscoped，worker拒绝最终diff下workflow修改并核实际发布ref；也受GitHub workflow权限控制。

quiz.source_question: What gating happens after the agent loop concludes, before opening a PR?
quiz.original_correct_option: Full CI runs in the sandbox; coverage delta is computed; PRs with a regression beyond a threshold are labeled needs-review
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q5 C为课程声明：CI/coveragepolicy在最终head执行；源码PYhalt与正文open冲突，本项目先统一严格/草案政策。

quiz.source_question: Which budget knobs does the dispatcher enforce per repo per day?
quiz.original_correct_option: A dollar ceiling per PR plus a maximum number of PRs per repo per day
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q6 B部分：daily总dollar+每jobceiling+PRcount均要查，还包含inflight预留；只cap每PR不是dailycap。

quiz.source_question: What goes into the PR body that the agent posts?
quiz.original_correct_option: Rationale, diff summary, trace URL, cost, and turn count so reviewers can audit and follow up
quiz.chinese_judgment: Q7 A：rationale、diff、trace授权URL、cost/turn、验证和未验边界，脱敏不泄token。

knowledge: Webhook验rawbytes HMAC SHA256→parse schema→核event/action/label/installation/repository允许范围/trigger actor资格→可靠enqueue+ACK→dailybudget原子reserve→worker lease。在受信metadata里固定baseSHA/issueID/revision与任务指纹；issue正文/repo文件是非可信数据不授权发消息/改workflow/装依赖。
同X-GitHub-Delivery重送不产生新job，业务指纹还防不同delivery同任务；重复处理同ID不同内容拒绝。签名只body，不假设X-GitHub-Event等全部headers签过，所以还核event schema/allowlist；签名通过不等源用户有dispatch权限。

安装token最多指定repo和permissions，1小时过期，App JWT是另一credential。不固化40char/token内部format；worker不持App私钥、publishing凭据分开。contents permission非path scoped，无forcepush权限位；受保护branch/rulesets无bypass+workerdiff/path/ref gate共同限制，主branch保护不自动保护所有agent branch。

锁定环境优先可信Dockerfile+runtime/packageManager+锁/registry来源，inferredDockerfile是待审核候选；install/build/test本身可执行恶意代码，不在高权限runner/有secret sandbox直接跑。localtests不等GitHub required checks，CI绑定base/head/config/environment/完整test和coverage定义；coverage<−2 source正文与PY相冲，最终设计先声明halt或draftneedsreview政策。
每天budget含spent+inflightreserved+unknownfees，job结束只释放确定剩余额；permit只判断没原子写reservation会并发超额。PR count同样在途reserve，按可信日界/tenant/repo分区。预算trip/cancel输出unfinished，不开verifiedPR；未知effect查目的端receipt避免重复push/PR。
dryrun仅产计划/diff候选，明确CI未跑的draft；不称review-ready/verified且不能默认外发。7天branch自动删除需核未merge/是否有人在用/保存patch+trace/用户scope，天数不是通用安全策略。50次flake复现失败0仅约束所测分布，不保永不flake；固定随机/资源/并发。
code_defects: PY ledger.permit称worstcase reserve但没有写inflight余额，只有顺序dispatch演示；并发多任务各permit通过可超日cap，没dayrollover/idempotency/dailyPRreservation。
PY can(action)未知动作全true、未核repo/permissions；open_pr只过期和can，未验证state=PR/ci_green/head/token.repo；可用别repo或跳VERIFY调用。
PY agentturncap20正文30，randomCI/coverage模拟，无真实sandbox/github/logscrub。coverage<-2 PYFAILED而正文/outputs说仍openneeds-review，必须统一且明确scope。
TS router在issues.opened无label直接dispatch，issue.number/title只typecast未runtimevalidate、repository/install无allowlist、no deliverydedupe，分支名issue号跨repo/重试冲突。
TS agentlog叫stub_pr_created不是真PR；README/YAML说明存在但当前课目录未任何YAML，不能覆盖已完成Actions。
TS Nodeadapter有1MiB限制，直接app请求可绕adapter，生产需边界一致；serve绑定所有interface但打印localhost不是localhost隔离。
